20.19: and say to Moses, `Speak you with us, and we hear, and let not God speak with us, lest we die.'
20.20: And Moses says to the people, `Fear not, for to try you has God come, and in order that His fear may be before your faces--that you sin not.'
20.21: And the people stand afar off, and Moses has drawn nigh to the thick darkness where God is.
20.22: And Jehovah says to Moses, `Thus do you say to the sons of Israel: You--you have seen that from the heavens I have spoken with you;
20.23: you do not make with Me gods of silver, even gods of gold you do not make to yourselves.
20.24: `An altar of earth you do make for Me, and you have sacrificed on it your burnt-offerings and your peace-offerings, your flock and your herd; in every place where I cause My name to be remembered I come in to you, and have blessed you.
20.25: `And if an altar of stones you do make to Me, you do not build them of hewn work; when your tool you have waved over it, then you do pollute it;
20.26: neither do you go up by steps on My altar, that your nakedness be not revealed upon it.

21.1: `And these are the judgments which you do set before them:
21.2: `When you buy a Hebrew servant--six years he does serve, and in the seventh he goes out as a freeman for nought;
21.3: if by himself he comes in, by himself he goes out; if he is owner of a wife, then his wife has gone out with him;
21.4: if his lord give to him a wife, and she has borne to him sons or daughters--the wife and her children are her lord's, and he goes out by himself.
21.5: `And if the servant really say: I have loved my lord, my wife, and my sons--I do not go out free;
21.6: then has his lord brought him nigh to God, and has brought him nigh to the door, or to the side-post, and his lord has bored his ear with an awl, and he has served him--to the age.
21.7: `And when a man sells his daughter for a handmaid, she does not go out according to the going out of the men-servants;
21.8: if evil in the eyes of her lord, so that he has not betrothed her, then he has let her be ransomed; to a strange people he has not power to sell her, in his dealing treacherously with her.
21.9: `And if to his son he betroth her, according to the right of daughters he does to her.
21.10: `If another woman he take for him, her food, her covering, and her habitation, he does not withdraw;
21.11: and if these three he do not to her, then she has gone out for nought, without money.
21.12: `He who smites a man so that he has died, is certainly put to death;
21.13: as to him who has not laid wait, and God has brought to his hand, I have even set for you a place where he does flee.
21.14: `And when a man does presume against his neighbour to slay him with subtilty, from My altar you do take him to die.
21.15: `And he who smites his father or his mother is certainly put to death.
21.16: `And he who steals a man, and has sold him, and he has been found in his hand, is certainly put to death.
21.17: `And he who is reviling his father or his mother is certainly put to death.
21.18: `And when men contend, and a man has smitten his neighbour with a stone, or with the fist, and he die not, but has fallen on the bed;
21.19: if he rise, and has gone up and down without on his staff, then has the smiter been acquitted; only his cessation he gives, and he is thoroughly healed.
21.20: `And when a man smites his man-servant or his handmaid, with a rod, and he has died under his hand--he is certainly avenged;
21.21: only if he remain a day, or two days, he is not avenged, for he is his money.
21.22: `And when men strive, and have smitten a pregnant woman, and her children have come out, and there is no mischief, he is certainly fined, as the husband of the woman does lay upon him, and he has given through the judges;
21.23: and if there is mischief, then you have given life for life,
21.24: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
21.25: burning for burning, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.
21.26: `And when a man smites the eye of his man-servant, or the eye of his handmaid, and has destroyed it, as a freeman he does send him away for his eye;
21.27: and if a tooth of his man-servant or a tooth of his handmaid he knock out, as a freeman he does send him away for his tooth.
21.28: `And when an ox does gore man or woman, and they have died, the ox is certainly stoned, and his flesh is not eaten, and the owner of the ox is acquitted;
21.29: and if the ox is one accustomed to gore heretofore, and it has been testified to its owner, and he does not watch it, and it has put to death a man or woman, the ox is stoned, and its owner also is put to death.
21.30: `If atonement is laid upon him, then he has given the ransom of his life, according to all that is laid upon him;
21.31: whether it gore a son or gore a daughter, according to this judgment it is done to him.
21.32: `If the ox gore a man-servant or a handmaid, thirty silver shekels he does give to their lord, and the ox is stoned.
21.33: `And when a man does open a pit, or when a man does dig a pit, and does not cover it, and an ox or ass has fallen there, --
21.34: the owner of the pit does repay, money he does give back to its owner, and the dead is his.
21.35: `And when a man's ox does smite the ox of his neighbour, and it has died, then they have sold the living ox, and halved its money, and also the dead one they do halve;
21.36: or, it has been known that the ox is one accustomed to gore heretofore, and its owner does not watch it, he certainly repays ox for ox, and the dead is his.

22.1: `When a man does steal an ox or sheep, and has slaughtered it or sold it, five of the herd he does repay for the ox, and four of the flock for the sheep.
22.2: `If in the breaking through, the thief is found, and he has been smitten, and has died, there is no blood for him;
22.3: if the sun has risen upon him, blood is for him, he does certainly repay; if he have nothing, then he has been sold for his theft;
22.4: if the theft is certainly found in his hand alive, whether ox, or ass, or sheep--double he repays.
22.5: `When a man depastureth a field or vineyard, and has sent out his beast, and it has pastured in the field of another, of the best of his field, and the best of his vineyard, he does repay.
22.6: `When fire goes forth, and has found thorns, and a stack, or the standing corn, or the field, has been consumed, he who causes the burning does certainly repay.
22.7: `When a man does give to his neighbour silver, or vessels to keep, and it has been stolen out of the man's house; if the thief is found, he repays double.
22.8: `If the thief is not found, then the master of the house has been brought near to God, whether he has not put forth his hand against the work of his neighbour;
22.9: for every matter of transgression, for ox, for ass, for sheep, for raiment, for any lost thing of which it is said that it is his; to God comes the matter of them both; he whom God does condemn, he repays double to his neighbour.
22.10: `When a man does give to his neighbour an ass, or ox, or sheep, or any beast to keep, and it has died, or has been hurt, or taken captive, none seeing--
22.11: an oath of Jehovah is between them both, that he has not put forth his hand against the work of his neighbour, and its owner has accepted, and he does not repay;
22.12: but if it is certainly stolen from him, he does repay to its owner;
22.13: if it is certainly torn, he brings it in--a witness; the torn thing he does not repay.
22.14: `And when a man does ask anything from his neighbour, and it has been hurt or has died--its owner not being with it--he does certainly repay;
22.15: if its owner is with it, he does not repay, --if it is a hired thing, it has come for its hire.
22.16: `And when a man does entice a virgin who is not betrothed, and has lain with her, he does certainly endow her to himself for a wife;
22.17: if her father utterly refuse to give her to him, money he does weigh out according to the dowry of virgins.
22.18: `A witch you do not keep alive.
22.19: `Whoever lies with a beast is certainly put to death.
22.20: `He who is sacrificing to a god, save to Jehovah alone, is devoted.
22.21: `And a sojourner you do not oppress, nor crush him, for sojourners you have been in the land of Egypt.
22.22: `Any widow or orphan you do not afflict;
22.23: if you do really afflict him, surely if he at all cry to Me, I certainly hear his cry;
22.24: and My anger has burned, and I have slain you by the sword, and your wives have been widows, and your sons orphans.
22.25: `If you do lend My poor people with you money, you are not to him as a usurer; you do not lay on him usury;
22.26: if you do at all take in pledge the garment of your neighbour, during the going in of the sun you do return it to him:
22.27: for it alone is his covering, it is his garment for his skin; in which does he lie down? and it has come to pass, when he does cry to Me, that I have heard, for I am gracious.
22.28: `God you do not revile, and a prince among your people you do not curse.
22.29: `Your fulness and your liquids you do not delay; the first-born of your sons you do give to Me;
22.30: so you do to your ox, to your sheep; seven days it is with its dam, on the eighth day you do give it to Me.
22.31: `And you are holy men to Me, and flesh torn in the field you do not eat, to a dog you do cast it.

23.1: `You do not lift up a vain report; you do not put your hand with a wicked man to be a violent witness.
23.2: `You are not after many to evil, nor do you testify concerning a strife, to turn aside after many to cause others to turn aside;
23.3: and a poor man you do not honour in his strife.
23.4: `When you meet your enemy's ox or his ass going astray, you do certainly turn it back to him;
23.5: when you see the ass of him who is hating you crouching under its burden, then you have ceased from leaving it to it--you do certainly leave it with him.
23.6: `You do not turn aside the judgment of your needy one in his strife;
23.7: from a false matter you do keep far off, and an innocent and righteous man you do not slay; for I do not justify a wicked man.
23.8: `And a bribe you do not take; for the bribe binds the open- eyed, and perverts the words of the righteous.
23.9: `And a sojourner you do not oppress, and you--you have known the soul of the sojourner, for sojourners you have been in the land of Egypt.
23.10: `And six years you do sow your land, and have gathered its increase;
23.11: and the seventh you do release it, and have left it, and the needy of your people have eaten, and their leaving does the beast of the field eat; so do you to your vineyard--to your olive-yard.
23.12: `Six days you do do your work, and on the seventh day you do rest, so that your ox and your ass does rest, and the son of your handmaid and the sojourner is refreshed;
23.13: and in all that which I have said to you you do take heed; and the name of other gods you do not mention; it is not heard on your mouth.
23.14: `Three times you do keep a feast to Me in a year;
23.15: the Feast of Unleavened things you do keep; seven days you do eat unleavened things, as I have commanded you, at the time appointed in the month of Abib; for in it you have come forth out of Egypt, and you do not appear in My presence empty;
23.16: and the Feast of Harvest, the first fruits of your works which you sow in the field; and the Feast of the In-Gathering, in the outgoing of the year, in your gathering your works out of the field.
23.17: `Three times in a year do all your males appear before the face of the Lord Jehovah.
23.18: `You do not sacrifice on a fermented thing the blood of My sacrifice, and the fat of My festival does not remain till morning;
23.19: the beginning of the first-fruits of your ground you do bring into the house of Jehovah your God; you do not boil a kid in its mother's milk.
23.20: `Indeed, I am sending a messenger before you to keep you in the way, and to bring you in to the place which I have prepared;
23.21: be watchful because of his presence, and hearken to his voice, rebel not against him, for he bears not with your transgression, for My name is in his heart;
23.22: for, if you diligently hearken to his voice, and have done all that which I speak, then I have been at enmity with your enemies, and have distressed those distressing you.
23.23: `For My messenger goes before you, and has brought you in to the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Canaanite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, and I have cut them off.
23.24: `You do not bow yourself to their gods, nor serve them, nor do according to their doings, but do utterly devote them, and thoroughly break their standing pillars.
23.25: `And you have served Jehovah your God, and He has blessed your bread and your water, and I have turned aside sickness from your heart;
23.26: there is not a miscarrying and barren one in your land; the number of your days I fulfil:
23.27: My terror I send before you, and I have put to death all the people among whom you come, and I have given the neck of all your enemies to you.
23.28: `And I have sent the hornet before you, and it has cast out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before you;
23.29: I cast them not out from before you in one year, lest the land be a desolation, and the beast of the field has multiplied against you;
23.30: little by little I cast them out from before you, till you are fruitful, and have inherited the land.
23.31: `And I have set your border from the Red Sea, even to the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the River: for I give into your hand the inhabitants of the land, and you have cast them out from before you;
23.32: you do not make a covenant with them, and with their gods;
23.33: they do not dwell in your land, lest they cause you to sin against Me when you serve their gods, when it becomes a snare to you.'

24.1: And to Moses He said, `Come up to Jehovah, you, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel, and you have bowed yourselves afar off;'
24.2: and Moses has drawn nigh by himself to Jehovah; and they draw not nigh, and the people go not up with him.
24.3: And Moses comes in, and recounts to the people all the words of Jehovah, and all the judgments, and all the people answer--one voice, and say, `All the words which Jehovah has spoken we do.'
24.4: And Moses writes all the words of Jehovah, and rises early in the morning, and builds an altar under the hill, and twelve standing pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel;
24.5: and he sends the youths of the sons of Israel, and they cause burnt-offerings to ascend, and sacrifice sacrifices of peace-offerings to Jehovah--calves.
24.6: And Moses takes half of the blood, and puts in basins, and half of the blood has he sprinkled on the altar;
24.7: and he takes the Book of the Covenant, and proclaims in the ears of the people, and they say, `All that which Jehovah has spoken we do, and obey.'
24.8: And Moses takes the blood, and sprinkles on the people, and says, `Indeed, the blood of the covenant which Jehovah has made with you, concerning all these things.'
24.9: And Moses goes up, Aaron also, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel,
24.10: and they see the God of Israel, and under His feet is as the white work of the sapphire, and as the substance of the heavens for purity;
24.11: and to those of the sons of Israel who are near He has not put forth His hand, and they see God, and eat and drink.
24.12: And Jehovah says to Moses, `Come up to Me to the mount, and be there, and I give to you the tables of stone, and the law, and the command, which I have written to direct them.'
24.13: And Moses rises--Joshua his minister also--and Moses goes up to the mount of God;
24.14: and to the elders he has said, `Abide you for us in this place, until that we turn back to you, and indeed, Aaron and Hur are with you--he who has matters does come nigh to them.'
24.15: And Moses goes up to the mount, and the cloud covers the mount;
24.16: and the honour of Jehovah does tabernacle on mount Sinai, and the cloud covers it six days, and He calls to Moses on the seventh day from the midst of the cloud.
24.17: And the appearance of the honour of Jehovah is as a consuming fire on the top of the mount, before the eyes of the sons of Israel;
24.18: and Moses goes into the midst of the cloud, and goes up to the mount, and Moses is on the mount forty days and forty nights.

25.1: And Jehovah speaks to Moses, saying,
25.2: `Speak to the sons of Israel, and they take for Me a heave-offering; from every man whose heart impelleth him you do take My heave-offering.
25.3: `And this is the heave-offering which you take from them; gold, and silver, and brass,
25.4: and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and linen, and goats' hair,
25.5: and rams' skins made red, and badgers' skins, and shittim wood,
25.6: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil, and for the perfume of the spices,
25.7: shoham stones, and stones for setting for an ephod, and for a breastplate.
25.8: `And they have made for Me a sanctuary, and I have tabernacled in their midst;
25.9: according to all that which I am shewing you, the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all its vessels, even so you do make it.
25.10: `And they have made an ark of shittim wood; two cubits and a half its length, and a cubit and a half its breadth, and a cubit and a half its height;
25.11: and you have overlaid it with pure gold, within and without you do overlay it, and you have made on it a ring of gold round about.
25.12: `And you have cast for it four rings of gold, and have put them on its four feet, even two rings on its one side, and two rings on its second side;
25.13: and you have made staves of shittim wood, and have overlaid them with gold,
25.14: and have brought the staves into the rings on the sides of the ark, to bear the ark by them,
25.15: in the rings of the ark are the staves, they are not turned aside from it;
25.16: and you have put to the ark the testimony which I give to you.
25.17: `And you have made a mercy-seat of pure gold, two cubits and a half its length, and a cubit and a half its breadth;
25.18: and you have made two cherubs of gold, beaten work do you make them, at the two ends of the mercy-seat;
25.19: and make you one cherub at the end on this side, and one cherub at the end on that; at the mercy-seat you do make the cherubs on its two ends.
25.20: `And the cherubs have been spreading out wings on high, covering the mercy-seat over with their wings, and their faces are one toward another--toward the mercy-seat are the faces of the cherubs.
25.21: `And you have put the mercy-seat on the ark above, and to the ark you do put the testimony which I give to you;
25.22: and I have met with you there, and have spoken with you from off the mercy-seat (from between the two cherubs, which are on the ark of the testimony) all that which I command you concerning the sons of Israel.
25.23: `And you have made a table of shittim wood, two cubits its length, and a cubit its breadth, and a cubit and a half its height,
25.24: and have overlaid it with pure gold, and have made for it a crown of gold round about,
25.25: and have made for it a border of a handbreadth round about, and have made a crown of gold to its border round about.
25.26: `And you have made to it four rings of gold, and have put the rings on the four corners, which are to its four feet;
25.27: over-against the border are the rings for places for staves to bear the table;
25.28: and you have made the staves of shittim wood, and have overlaid them with gold, and the table has been borne with them;
25.29: and you have made its dishes, and its bowls, and its covers, and its cups, with which they pour out; of pure gold you do make them;
25.30: and you have put on the table bread of the presence before Me continually.
25.31: `And you have made a candlestick of pure gold, of beaten work is the candlestick made; its base, and its branch, its calyxes, its knops, and its flowers are of the same;
25.32: and six branches are coming out of its sides, three branches of the candlestick out of the one side, and three branches of the candlestick out of the second side;
25.33: three calyxes made like almonds in the one branch, a knop and a flower, and three calyxes made like almonds in one branch, a knop and a flower; so for the six branches which are coming out from the candlestick.
25.34: `And in the candlestick are four calyxes made like almonds, its knops and its flowers;
25.35: and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, are to the six branches which are coming out of the candlestick;
25.36: their knops and their branches are of the same, all of it one beaten work of pure gold;
25.37: and you have made its seven lamps, and one has caused its lights to go up, and it has given light over-against its front.
25.38: `And its snuffers and its snuff dishes are of pure gold;
25.39: of a talent of pure gold he does make it, with all these vessels.
25.40: And see you and do them by their pattern which you are shown in the mount.

26.1: `And you do make the tabernacle: ten curtains of twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet; with cherubs, work of a designer, you do make them;
26.2: the length of the one curtain is eight and twenty by the cubit, and the breadth of the one curtain four by the cubit, one measure is to all the curtains;
26.3: five of the curtains are joining one to another, and five curtains are joining one to another.
26.4: `And you have made loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain, at the end in the joining; and so you make in the edge of the outermost curtain, in the joining of the second.
26.5: fifty loops you do make in the one curtain, and fifty loops you do make in the edge of the curtain which is in the joining of the second, causing the loops to take hold one to another;
26.6: and you have made fifty hooks of gold, and have joined the curtains one to another by the hooks, and the tabernacle has been one.
26.7: `And you have made curtains of goats' hair, for a tent over the tabernacle; you do make eleven curtains:
26.8: the length of the one curtain is thirty by the cubit, and the breadth of the one curtain four by the cubit; one measure is to the eleven curtains;
26.9: and you have joined the five curtains apart, and the six curtains apart, and have doubled the six curtains over-against the front of the tent.
26.10: `And you have made fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain, the outermost in the joining, and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which is joining the second;
26.11: and you have made fifty hooks of brass, and have brought in the hooks into the loops, and have joined the tent, and it has been one.
26.12: `And the superfluity in the curtains of the tent--the half of the curtain which is superfluous--has spread over the hinder part of the tabernacle;
26.13: and the cubit on this side, and the cubit on that, in the superfluity in the length of the curtains of the tent, is spread out over the sides of the tabernacle, on this and on that, to cover it;
26.14: and you have made a covering for the tent, of rams' skins made red, and a covering of badgers' skins above.
26.15: `And you have made the boards for the tabernacle, of shittim wood, standing up;
26.16: ten cubits is the length of the board, and a cubit and a half the breadth of the one board;
26.17: two handles are to the one board, joined one to another; so you do make for all the boards of the tabernacle;
26.18: and you have made the boards of the tabernacle: twenty boards for the south side southward;
26.19: and forty sockets of silver you do make under the twenty boards, two sockets under the one board for its two handles, and two sockets under the other board for its two handles.
26.20: `And for the second side of the tabernacle, for the north side, are twenty boards,
26.21: and their forty sockets of silver, two sockets under the one board, and two sockets under another board.
26.22: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward, you do make six boards.
26.23: And two boards you do make for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.
26.24: And they are pairs beneath, and together they are pairs above its head to the one ring; so is it for them both, they are for the two corners.
26.25: And they have been eight boards, and their sockets of silver are sixteen sockets, two sockets under the one board, and two sockets under another board.
26.26: `And you have made bars of shittim wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
26.27: and five bars for the boards of the second side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle at the two sides, westward;
26.28: and one has caused the middle bar in the midst of the boards to reach from end to end;
26.29: and the boards you do overlay with gold, and their rings you do make of gold places for bars, and have overlaid their bars with gold;
26.30: and you have raised up the tabernacle according to its fashion which you have been shown in the mount.
26.31: `And you have made a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen, work of a designer; he makes it with cherubs;
26.32: and you have put it on four pillars of shittim wood, overlaid with gold, their pegs are of gold, on four sockets of silver.
26.33: `And you have put the vail under the hooks, and have brought in there within the vail the ark of the testimony; and the vail has made a separation for you between the holy and the holy of holies.
26.34: `And you have put the mercy-seat on the ark of the testimony, in the holy of holies.
26.35: `And you have set the table at the outside of the vail, and the candlestick over-against the table on the side of the tabernacle southward, and the table you do put on the north side.
26.36: `And you have made a covering for the opening of the tent, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen, work of an embroiderer;
26.37: and you have made for the covering five pillars of shittim wood, and have overlaid them with gold, their pegs are of gold, and you have cast for them five sockets of brass.

27.1: `And you have made the altar of shittim wood, five cubits the length, and five cubits the breadth--the altar is square--and three cubits its height.
27.2: And you have made its horns on its four corners, its horns are of the same, and you have overlaid it with brass.
27.3: And you have made its pots to remove its ashes, and its shovels, and its bowls, and its forks, and its fire-pans, even all its vessels you do make of brass.
27.4: `And you have made for it a grate of net-work of brass, and have made on the net four rings of brass on its four extremities,
27.5: and have put it under the compass of the altar beneath, and the net has been to the middle of the altar.
27.6: `And you have made staves for the altar, staves of shittim wood, and have overlaid them with brass.
27.7: And the staves have been brought into the rings, and the staves have been on the two sides of the altar in bearing it.
27.8: Hollow with boards you do make it, as it has been showed you in the mount, so do they make it.
27.9: `And you have made the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward, hangings for the court of twined linen, a hundred by the cubit is the length for the one side,
27.10: and its twenty pillars and their twenty sockets are of brass, the pegs of the pillars and their fillets are of silver;
27.11: and so for the north side in length, hangings of a hundred cubits in length, and its twenty pillars and their twenty sockets are of brass, the pegs of the pillars and their fillets are of silver.
27.12: `And for the breadth of the court at the west side are hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.
27.13: And for the breadth of the court at the east side, eastward, are fifty cubits.
27.14: And the hangings at the side are fifteen cubits, their pillars three, and their sockets three.
27.15: And at the second side are hangings fifteen cubits, their pillars three, and their sockets three.
27.16: `And for the gate of the court a covering of twenty cubits, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen, work of an embroiderer; their pillars four, their sockets four.
27.17: All the pillars of the court round about are filleted with silver, their pegs are silver, and their sockets brass.
27.18: `The length of the court is a hundred by the cubit, and the breadth fifty by fifty, and the height five cubits, of twined linen, and their sockets are brass,
27.19: even all the vessels of the tabernacle, in all its service, and all its pins, and all the pins of the court, are brass.
27.20: `And you--you do command the sons of Israel, and they bring to you pure beaten olive oil for the light, to cause the lamp to go up continually;
27.21: in the tent of meeting, at the outside of the vail, which is over the testimony, does Aaron--his sons also--arrange it from evening till morning before Jehovah--a statute age-during to their generations, from the sons of Israel.

28.1: `And you, bring you near to you Aaron your brother, and his sons with him, from the midst of the sons of Israel, for his being priest to Me, even Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, sons of Aaron;
28.2: and you have made holy garments for Aaron your brother, for honour and for beauty;
28.3: and you--you do speak to all the wise of heart, whom I have filled with a spirit of wisdom, and they have made the garments of Aaron to sanctify him for his being priest to Me.
28.4: `And these are the garments which they make: a breastplate, and an ephod, and an upper robe, and an embroidered coat, a mitre, and a girdle; yes, they have made holy garments for Aaron your brother, and for his sons, for his being priest to Me.
28.5: `And they take the gold, and the blue, and the purple, and the scarlet, and the linen,
28.6: and have made the ephod of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen, work of a designer;
28.7: it has two shoulders joining at its two ends, and it is joined.
28.8: `And the girdle of his ephod which is on him, according to its work, is of the same, of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen.
28.9: `And you have taken the two shoham stones, and have opened on them the names of the sons of Israel;
28.10: six of their names on the one stone, and the names of the remaining six on the second stone, according to their births;
28.11: the work of an engraver in stone, openings of a signet, you do open the two stones by the names of the sons of Israel; turned round, embroidered with gold, you do make them.
28.12: `And you have set the two stones on the shoulders of the ephod--stones of memorial to the sons of Israel--and Aaron has borne their names before Jehovah, on his two shoulders, for a memorial.
28.13: `And you have made embroidered things of gold,
28.14: and two chains of pure gold, wreathed work you do make them, work of thick bands, and you have put the thick chains on the embroidered things.
28.15: `And you have made a breastplate of judgment, work of a designer; according to the work of the ephod you do make it; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen you do make it;
28.16: it is square, doubled, a span its length, and a span its breadth.
28.17: `And you have set in it settings of stone, four rows of stone; a row of sardius, topaz, and carbuncle is the first row;
28.18: and the second row is emerald, sapphire, and diamond;
28.19: and the third row is opal, agate, and amethyst;
28.20: and the fourth row is beryl, and onyx, and jasper; embroidered with gold are they in their settings,
28.21: and the stones are according to the names of the sons of Israel, twelve, according to their names, openings of a signet, each by his name are they for the twelve tribes.
28.22: `And you have made on the breastplate wreathed chains, work of thick bands, of pure gold;
28.23: and you have made on the breastplate two rings of gold, and have put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate;
28.24: and you have put the two thick bands of gold on the two rings at the ends of the breastplate;
28.25: and the two ends of the two thick bands you do put on the two embroidered things, and you have put them on the shoulders of the ephod over-against its face.
28.26: `And you have made two rings of gold, and have set them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its border, which is over-against the ephod within;
28.27: and you have made two rings of gold, and have put them on the two shoulders of the ephod, beneath, over-against its front, over-against its joining, above the girdle of the ephod,
28.28: and they bind the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a ribbon of blue, to be above the girdle of the ephod, and the breastplate is not loosed from the ephod.
28.29: `And Aaron has borne the names of the sons of Israel in the breastplate of judgment, on his heart, in his going in to the sanctuary, for a memorial before Jehovah continually.
28.30: `And you have put to the breastplate of judgment the Lights and the Perfections, and they have been on the heart of Aaron, in his going in before Jehovah, and Aaron has borne the judgment of the sons of Israel on his heart before Jehovah continually.
28.31: `And you have made the upper robe of the ephod completely of blue,
28.32: and the opening for its head has been in its midst, a border is to its opening round about, work of a weaver, as the opening of a habergeon there is to it; it is not rent.
28.33: `And you have made on its hem pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, on its hem round about, and bells of gold in their midst round about;
28.34: a bell of gold and a pomegranate, a bell of gold and a pomegranate are on the hems of the upper robe round about.
28.35: `And it has been on Aaron to minister in, and its sound has been heard in his coming in to the sanctuary before Jehovah, and in his going out, and he does not die.
28.36: `And you have made a flower of pure gold, and have opened on it--openings of a signet--`Holy to Jehovah;'
28.37: and you have put it on a blue ribbon, and it has been on the mitre--over-against the front of the mitre it is;
28.38: and it has been on the forehead of Aaron, and Aaron has borne the iniquity of the holy things which the sons of Israel do hallow, even all their holy gifts; and it has been on his forehead continually for a pleasing thing for them before Jehovah.
28.39: `And you have embroidered the coat of linen, and have made a mitre of linen, and a girdle you do make--work of an embroiderer.
28.40: `And for the sons of Aaron you do make coats, and you have made for them girdles, yes, bonnets you do make for them, for honour and for beauty;
28.41: and you have clothed Aaron your brother with them, and his sons with him, and have anointed them, and have consecrated their hand, and have sanctified them, and they have been priests to Me.
28.42: `And make you for them linen trousers to cover the naked flesh: they are from the loins even to the thighs;
28.43: and they have been on Aaron and on his sons, in their going in to the tent of meeting, or in their drawing nigh to the altar to minister in the sanctuary, and they do not bear iniquity nor have they died; a statute age-during to him, and to his seed after him.

29.1: `And this is the thing which you do to them, to hallow them, for being priests to Me: Take one bullock, a son of the herd, and two rams, perfect ones,
29.2: and bread unleavened, and cakes unleavened anointed with oil, of fine wheaten flour you do make them,
29.3: and you have put them on one basket, and have brought them near in the basket, also the bullock and the two rams.
29.4: `And Aaron and his sons you do bring near to the opening of the tent of meeting, and have bathed them with water;
29.5: and you have taken the garments, and have clothed Aaron with the coat, and the upper robe of the ephod, and the ephod, and the breastplate, and have girded him with the girdle of the ephod,
29.6: and have set the mitre on his head, and have put the holy crown on the mitre,
29.7: and have taken the anointing oil, and have poured it on his head, and have anointed him.
29.8: `And his sons you do bring near, and have clothed them with coats,
29.9: and have girded them with a girdle (Aaron and his sons), and have bound on them bonnets; and the priesthood has been theirs by a statute age-during, and you have consecrated the hand of Aaron, and the hand of his sons,
29.10: and have brought near the bullock before the tent of meeting, and Aaron has laid--his sons also--their hands on the head of the bullock.
29.11: `And you have slaughtered the bullock before Jehovah, at the opening of the tent of meeting,
29.12: and have taken of the blood of the bullock, and have put it on the horns of the altar with your finger, and all the blood you do pour out at the foundation of the altar;
29.13: and you have taken all the fat which is covering the inwards, and the redundance on the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat which is on them, and have made perfume on the altar;
29.14: and the flesh of the bullock, and his skin, and his dung, you do burn with fire at the outside of the camp; it is a sin-offering.
29.15: `And the one ram you do take, and Aaron and his sons have laid their hands on the head of the ram,
29.16: and you have slaughtered the ram, and have taken its blood, and have sprinkled it on the altar round about,
29.17: and the ram you do cut into its pieces, and have washed its inwards, and its legs, and have put them on its pieces, and on its head;
29.18: and you have made perfume with the whole ram on the altar. It is a burnt-offering to Jehovah, a sweet fragrance; a fire-offering it is to Jehovah.
29.19: `And you have taken the second ram, and Aaron has laid--his sons also--their hands on the head of the ram,
29.20: and you have slaughtered the ram, and have taken of its blood, and have put on the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and on the tip of the right ear of his sons, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the great toe of their right foot, and have sprinkled the blood on the altar round about;
29.21: and you have taken of the blood which is on the altar, and of the anointing oil, and have sprinkled on Aaron, and on his garments, and on his sons, and on the garments of his sons with him, and he has been hallowed, he, and his garments, and his sons, and the garments of his sons with him.
29.22: `And you have taken from the ram the fat, and the fat tail, and the fat which is covering the inwards, and the redundance on the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat which is on them, and the right leg, for it is a ram of consecration,
29.23: and one round cake of bread, and one cake of oiled bread, and one thin cake out of the basket of the unleavened things which is before Jehovah.
29.24: `And you have set the whole on the hands of Aaron, and on the hands of his sons, and have waved them--a wave-offering before Jehovah;
29.25: and you have taken them out of their hand, and have made perfume on the altar beside the burnt-offering, for sweet fragrance before Jehovah; a fire-offering it is to Jehovah.
29.26: `And you have taken the breast from the ram of the consecration which is for Aaron, and have waved it--a wave-offering before Jehovah, and it has become your portion;
29.27: and you have sanctified the breast of the wave-offering, and the leg of the heave-offering, which has been waved, and which has been lifted up from the ram of the consecration, of that which is for Aaron, and of that which is for his sons;
29.28: and it has been for Aaron and for his sons, by a statute age-during from the sons of Israel, for it is a heave-offering; and it is a heave offering from the sons of Israel, from the sacrifices of their peace-offerings--their heave-offering to Jehovah.
29.29: `And the holy garments which are Aaron's, are for his sons after him, to be anointed in them, and to consecrate in them their hand;
29.30: seven days does the priest in his stead (of his sons) put them on, when he goes in to the tent of meeting, to minister in the sanctuary.
29.31: `And the ram of the consecration you do take, and have boiled its flesh in the holy place;
29.32: and Aaron has eaten--his sons also--the flesh of the ram, and the bread which is in the basket, at the opening of the tent of meeting;
29.33: and they have eaten those things by which there is atonement to consecrate their hand, to sanctify them; and a stranger does not eat--for they are holy;
29.34: and if there be left of the flesh of the consecration or of the bread till the morning, then you have burned that which is left with fire; it is not eaten, for it is holy.
29.35: `And you have done thus to Aaron and to his sons, according to all that I have commanded you; seven days you do consecrate their hand;
29.36: and a bullock, a sin-offering, you do prepare daily for the atonements, and you have atoned for the altar, in your making atonement on it, and have anointed it to sanctify it;
29.37: seven days you do make atonement for the altar, and have sanctified it, and the altar has been most holy; all that is coming against the altar is holy.
29.38: `And this is that which you do prepare on the altar; two lambs, sons of a year, daily continually;
29.39: the one lamb you do prepare in the morning, and the second lamb you do prepare between the evenings;
29.40: and a tenth deal of fine flour, mixed with beaten oil, a fourth part of a hin, and a libation, a fourth part of a hin, of wine, is for the one lamb.
29.41: `And the second lamb you do prepare between the evenings; according to the present of the morning, and according to its libation, you do prepare for it, for sweet fragrance, a fire-offering, to Jehovah: --
29.42: a continual burnt-offering for your generations, at the opening of the tent of meeting, before Jehovah, where I am met with you, to speak to you there,
29.43: and I have met there with the sons of Israel, and it has been sanctified by My honour.
29.44: `And I have sanctified the tent of meeting, and the altar, and Aaron and his sons I sanctify for being priests to Me,
29.45: and I have tabernacled in the midst of the sons of Israel, and have become their God,
29.46: and they have known that I am Jehovah their God, who has brought them out of the land of Egypt, that I may tabernacle in their midst; I am Jehovah their God.

30.1: `And you have made an altar for making perfume; of shittim wood you do make it;
30.2: a cubit its length, and a cubit its breadth, (it is square), and two cubits its height; its horns are of the same.
30.3: `And you have overlaid it with pure gold, its top, and its sides round about, and its horns; and you have made to it a crown of gold round about;
30.4: and two rings of gold you do make to it under its crown; on its two ribs you do make them, on its two sides, and they have become places for staves, to bear it with them.
30.5: `And you have made the staves of shittim wood, and have overlaid them with gold;
30.6: and you have put it before the vail, which is by the ark of the testimony, before the mercy-seat which is over the testimony, where I am met with you.
30.7: `And Aaron has made perfume on it, perfume of spices, morning by morning; in his making the lamps right he does perfume it,
30.8: and in Aaron's causing the lamps to go up between the evenings, he does perfume it; a continual perfume before Jehovah to your generations.
30.9: `You do not cause strange perfume to go up upon it, and burnt-offering, and present, and libation you do not pour out on it;
30.10: and Aaron has made atonement on its horns, once in a year, by the blood of the sin-offering of atonements; once in a year does he make atonement for it, to your generations; it is most holy to Jehovah.'
30.11: And Jehovah speaks to Moses, saying,
30.12: `When you take up the sum of the sons of Israel for their numbers, then they have given each an atonement for his soul to Jehovah in their being numbered, and there is no plague among them in their being numbered.
30.13: `This they do give, every one passing over to those numbered, half a shekel, by the shekel of the sanctuary (the shekel is twenty gerahs); half a shekel is the heave-offering to Jehovah;
30.14: every one passing over to those numbered, from a son of twenty years and upwards, does give the heave-offering of Jehovah;
30.15: the rich does not multiply, and the poor does not diminish from the half-shekel, to give the heave-offering of Jehovah, to make atonement for your souls.
30.16: `And you have taken the atonement-money from the sons of Israel, and have given it for the service of the tent of meeting; and it has been to the sons of Israel for a memorial before Jehovah, to make atonement for your souls.'
30.17: And Jehovah speaks to Moses, saying,
30.18: `And you have made a laver of brass (and its base of brass), for washing; and you have put it between the tent of meeting and the altar, and have put water there;
30.19: and Aaron and his sons have washed at it their hands and their feet,
30.20: in their going in to the tent of meeting they wash with water, and die not; or in their drawing nigh to the altar to minister, to perfume a fire-offering to Jehovah,
30.21: then they have washed their hands and their feet, and they die not, and it has been to them a statute age-during, to him and to his seed to their generations.'
30.22: And Jehovah speaks to Moses, saying,
30.23: `And you, take to yourself principal spices, wild honey five hundred shekels; and spice-cinnamon, the half of that, two hundred and fifty; and spice-cane two hundred and fifty;
30.24: and cassia five hundred, by the shekel of the sanctuary, and olive oil a hin;
30.25: and you have made it a holy anointing oil, a compound mixture, work of a compounder; it is a holy anointing oil.
30.26: `And you have anointed with it the tent of meeting, and the ark of the testimony,
30.27: and the table and all its vessels, and the candlestick and its vessels, and the altar of perfume,
30.28: and the altar of burnt-offering and all its vessels, and the laver and its base;
30.29: and you have sanctified them, and they have been most holy; all that is coming against them is holy;
30.30: and Aaron and his sons you do anoint, and have sanctified them for being priests to Me.
30.31: `And to the sons of Israel you do speak, saying, A holy anointing oil is this to Me, to your generations;
30.32: on flesh of man it is not poured, and with its proper proportion you make none like it; it is holy; it is holy to you;
30.33: a man who compounds any like it, or who puts of it on a stranger--has even been cut off from his people.'
30.34: And Jehovah says to Moses, `Take to you spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum, spices and pure frankincense; they are part for part;
30.35: and you have made it a perfume, a compound, work of a compounder, salted, pure, holy;
30.36: and you have beaten some of it small, and have put of it before the testimony, in the tent of meeting, where I am met with you; most holy it is to you.
30.37: `As to the perfume which you make, with its proper proportion you do not make to yourselves, holy it is to you to Jehovah;
30.38: a man who makes any like it--to be refreshed by it--has even been cut off from his people.'

31.1: And Jehovah speaks to Moses, saying,
31.2: `See, I have called by name Bezaleel, son of Uri, son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah,
31.3: and I fill him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all work,
31.4: to devise devices to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
31.5: and in graving of stone for settings, and in graving of wood to work in all work.
31.6: `And I, indeed, I have given with him Aholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, and in the heart of every wise-hearted one I have given wisdom, and they have made all that which I have commanded you.
31.7: `The tent of meeting, and the ark of testimony, and the mercy-seat which is on it, and all the vessels of the tent,
31.8: and the table and its vessels, and the pure candlestick and all its vessels, and the altar of the perfume,
31.9: and the altar of the burnt-offering and all its vessels, and the laver and its base,
31.10: and the coloured garments, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, for acting as priests in;
31.11: and the anointing oil, and the perfume of the spices for the sanctuary; according to all that I have commanded you--they do.'
31.12: And Jehovah speaks to Moses, saying,
31.13: `And you, speak to the sons of Israel, saying, Only, My sabbaths you do keep, for it is a sign between Me and you, to your generations, to know that I, Jehovah, am sanctifying you;
31.14: and you have kept the sabbath, for it is holy to you, he who is polluting it is certainly put to death--for any who does work in it--that person has even been cut off from the midst of his people.
31.15: `Six days is work done, and in the seventh day is a sabbath of holy rest to Jehovah; any who does work in the sabbath-day is certainly put to death,
31.16: and the sons of Israel have observed the sabbath; to keep the sabbath to their generations is a covenant age-during,
31.17: between Me and the sons of Israel it is a sign--to the age; for six days Jehovah made the heavens and the earth, and in the seventh day He has ceased, and is refreshed.'
31.18: And He gives to Moses, when He finishes speaking with him in mount Sinai, two tables of the testimony, tables of stone, written by the finger of God.

32.1: And the people see that Moses is delaying to come down from the mount, and the people assemble against Aaron, and say to him, `Rise, make for us gods who go before us, for this Moses--the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt--we have not known what has happened to him.'
32.2: And Aaron says to them, `Break off the rings of gold which are in the ears of your wives, your sons, and your daughters, and bring in to me;'
32.3: and all the people themselves break off the rings of gold which are in their ears, and bring in to Aaron,
32.4: and he receives from their hand, and does fashion it with a graving tool, and does make it a molten calf, and they say, `These your gods, O Israel, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt.'
32.5: And Aaron sees, and builds an altar before it, and Aaron calls, and says, `A festival to Jehovah--to-morrow;'
32.6: and they rise early on the morrow, and cause burnt-offerings to ascend, and bring nigh peace-offerings; and the people sit down to eat and to drink, and rise up to play.
32.7: And Jehovah says to Moses, `Go, descend, for your people whom you have brought up out of the land of Egypt has done corruptly,
32.8: they have turned aside hastily from the way that I have commanded them; they have made for themselves a molten calf, and bow themselves to it, and sacrifice to it, and say, These your gods, O Israel, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt.'
32.9: And Jehovah says to Moses, `I have seen this people, and indeed, it is a stiff-necked people;
32.10: and now, let Me alone, and My anger does burn against them, and I consume them, and I make you become a great nation.'
32.11: And Moses appeases the face of Jehovah his God, and says, `Why, O Jehovah, does Your anger burn against Your people, whom You have brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power and with a strong hand?
32.12: why do the Egyptians speak, saying, For evil He brought them out to slay them among mountains, and to consume them from off the face of the ground? turn back from the heat of Your anger, and repent of the evil against Your people.
32.13: `Be mindful of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, Your servants, to whom You have sworn by Yourself, and to whom You speak: I multiply your seed as stars of the heavens, and all this land, as I have said, I give to your seed, and they have inherited to the age;'
32.14: and Jehovah repents of the evil which He has spoken of doing to His people.
32.15: And Moses turns, and goes down from the mount, and the two tables of the testimony are in his hand, tables written on both their sides, on this and on that are they written;
32.16: and the tables are the work of God, and the writing is the writing of God, graven on the tables.
32.17: And Joshua hears the voice of the people in their shouting, and says to Moses, `A noise of battle in the camp!'
32.18: and he says, `It is not the voice of the crying of might, nor is it the voice of the crying of weakness--a voice of singing I am hearing.'
32.19: And it comes to pass, when he has drawn near to the camp, that he sees the calf, and the dancing, and the anger of Moses burns, and he casts out of his hands the tables, and breaks them under the mount;
32.20: and he takes the calf which they have made, and burns it with fire, and grinds until it is small, and scatters on the face of the waters, and causes the sons of Israel to drink.
32.21: And Moses says to Aaron, `What has this people done to you, that you have brought in upon it a great sin?'
32.22: and Aaron says, `Let not the anger of my lord burn; you--you have known the people that it is in evil;
32.23: and they say to me, Make for us gods, who go before us, for this Moses--the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt--we have not known what has happened to him;
32.24: and I say to them, Whoever has gold, let them break it off, and they give to me, and I cast it into the fire, and this calf comes out.'
32.25: And Moses sees the people that it is unbridled, for Aaron has made it unbridled for contempt among its withstanders,
32.26: and Moses stands in the gate of the camp, and says, `Who is for Jehovah? --to me!' and all the sons of Levi are gathered to him;
32.27: and he says to them, `Thus said Jehovah, God of Israel, Put each his sword by his thigh, pass over and turn back from gate to gate through the camp, and slay each his brother, and each his friend, and each his relation.'
32.28: And the sons of Levi do according to the word of Moses, and there fall of the people on that day about three thousand men,
32.29: and Moses says, `Consecrate your hand to-day to Jehovah, for a man is against his son, and against his brother, so as to bring on you to-day a blessing.'
32.30: And it comes to pass, on the morrow, that Moses says to the people, `You--you have sinned a great sin, and now I go up to Jehovah, if so be I atone for your sin.'
32.31: And Moses turns back to Jehovah, and says, `Oh this people has sinned a great sin, that they make to themselves a god of gold;
32.32: and now, if You take away their sin--and if not--blot me, I pray you, out of Your book which You have written.'
32.33: And Jehovah says to Moses, `Whoever has sinned against Me--I blot him out of My book;
32.34: and now, go, lead the people wherever I have spoken to you of; indeed, My messenger goes before you, and in the day of my charging--then I have charged upon them their sin.'
32.35: And Jehovah plagues the people, because they made the calf which Aaron made.

33.1: And Jehovah speaks to Moses, `Go, ascend from this place, you and the people, whom you have brought up out of the land of Egypt, to the land which I have sworn to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, To your seed I give it,'
33.2: (and I have sent before you a messenger, and have cast out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite,)
33.3: to a land flowing with milk and honey, for I do not go up in your midst, for you are a stiff-necked people--lest I consume you in the way.'
33.4: And the people hear this sad thing, and mourn; and none put his ornaments on him.
33.5: And Jehovah says to Moses, `Say to the sons of Israel, You are a stiff-necked people; one moment--I come up into your midst, and have consumed you; and now, put down your ornaments from off you, and I know what I do to you;'
33.6: and the sons of Israel take off their ornaments at mount Horeb.
33.7: And Moses takes the tent, and has stretched it out at the outside of the camp, afar off from the camp, and has called it, `Tent of Meeting;' and it has come to pass, every one seeking Jehovah goes out to the tent of meeting, which is at the outside of the camp.
33.8: And it has come to pass, at the going out of Moses to the tent, all the people rise, and have stood, each at the opening of his tent, and have looked expectingly after Moses, until his going into the tent.
33.9: And it has come to pass, at the going in of Moses to the tent, the pillar of the cloud comes down, and has stood at the opening of the tent, and He has spoken with Moses;
33.10: and all the people have seen the pillar of the cloud standing at the opening of the tent, and all the people have risen and bowed themselves, each at the opening of his tent.
33.11: And Jehovah has spoken to Moses face to face, as a man speaks to his friend; and he has turned back to the camp, and his minister Joshua, son of Nun, a youth, departs not out of the tent.
33.12: And Moses says to Jehovah, `See, You are saying to me, Bring up this people, and You have not caused me to know whom You do send with me; and You have said, I have known you by name, and also you have found grace in My eyes.
33.13: `And now, if, I pray You, I have found grace in Your eyes, cause me to know, I pray You, Your way, and I know You, so that I find grace in Your eyes, and consider that this nation is Your people;'
33.14: and He says, `My presence does go, and I have given rest to you.'
33.15: And he says to Him, `If Your presence is not going--take us not up from this place;
33.16: and in what is it known now, that I have found grace in Your eyes--I and Your people--is it not in Your going with us? and we have been distinguished--I and Your people--from all the people who are on the face of the ground.'
33.17: And Jehovah says to Moses, `Even this thing which you have spoken I do; for you have found grace in My eyes, and I know you by name.'
33.18: And he says, `Show me, I pray You, Your honour;'
33.19: and He says, `I cause all My goodness to pass before your face, and have called concerning the Name of Jehovah before you, and favoured him whom I favour, and loved him whom I love.'
33.20: He says also, `You are unable to see My face, for man does not see Me, and live;'
33.21: Jehovah also says, `Indeed, a place is by Me, and you have stood on the rock,
33.22: and it has come to pass, in the passing by of My honour, that I have set you in a cleft of the rock, and spread out My hands over you, until My passing by,
33.23: and I have turned aside My hands, and you have seen My back parts, and My face is not seen.'

34.1: And Jehovah says to Moses, `Hew for yourself two tables of stone like the first, and I have written on the tables the words which were on the first tables which you have broken;
34.2: and be prepared at morning, and you have come up in the morning to mount Sinai, and have stood before Me there, on the top of the mount,
34.3: and no man comes up with you, and also no man is seen in all the mount, also the flock and the herd do not feed over-against that mount.'
34.4: And he hews two tables of stone like the first, and Moses rises early in the morning, and goes up to mount Sinai, as Jehovah commanded him, and he takes in his hand two tables of stone.
34.5: And Jehovah comes down in a cloud, and stations Himself with him there, and calls in the Name of Jehovah,
34.6: and Jehovah passes over before his face, and calls: `Jehovah, Jehovah God, merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in kindness and truth,
34.7: keeping kindness for thousands, taking away iniquity, and transgression, and sin, and not entirely acquitting, charging iniquity of fathers on children, and on children's children, on a third generation, and on a fourth.'
34.8: And Moses hastes, and bows to the earth, and does obeisance,
34.9: and says, `If, I pray You, I have found grace in Your eyes, O my Lord, let my Lord, I pray You, go in our midst (for it is a stiff-necked people), and you have forgiven our iniquity and our sin, and have inherited us.'
34.10: And He says, `Indeed, I am making a covenant: before all your people I do wonders, which have not been done in all the earth, or in any nation, and all the people in whose did you mid are have seen the work of Jehovah, for it is fearful that which I am doing with you.
34.11: `Observe for yourself that which I am commanding you to-day: indeed, I am casting out from before you the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite;
34.12: take heed to yourself, lest you make a covenant with the inhabitant of the land into which you are going, lest it become a snare in your midst;
34.13: for their altars you break down, and their standing pillars you shiver, and its shrines you cut down;
34.14: for you do not bow yourselves to another god--for Jehovah, whose name is Zealous, is a zealous God.
34.15: `Lest you make a covenant with the inhabitant of the land, and they have gone a-whoring after their gods, and have sacrificed to their gods, and one has called to you, and you have eaten of his sacrifice,
34.16: and you have taken of their daughters to your sons, and their daughters have gone a-whoring after their gods, and have caused your sons to go a-whoring after their gods;
34.17: a molten god you do not make to yourself.
34.18: `The feast of unleavened things you do keep; seven days you do eat unleavened things, as I have commanded you, at an appointed time, the month of Abib: for in the month of Abib you did come out from Egypt.
34.19: `All opening a womb are Mine, and every firstling of your cattle born a male, ox or sheep;
34.20: and the firstling of an ass you do ransom with a lamb; and if you do not ransom, then you have beheaded it; every first-born of your sons you do ransom, and they do not appear before Me empty.
34.21: `Six days you do work, and on the seventh day you do rest; in ploughing-time and in harvest you do rest.
34.22: `And a feast of weeks you do observe for yourself; first-fruits of wheat-harvest; and the feast of in-gathering, at the revolution of the year.
34.23: `Three times in a year do all your males appear before the Lord Jehovah, God of Israel;
34.24: for I dispossess nations from before you, and have enlarged your border, and no man does desire your land in your going up to appear before Jehovah your God three times in a year.
34.25: `You do not slaughter with a fermented thing the blood of My sacrifice; and the sacrifice of the feast of the passover does not remain till morning:
34.26: the first of the first-fruits of the land you do bring into the house of Jehovah your God; you do not boil a kid in its mother's milk.'
34.27: And Jehovah says to Moses, `Write for yourself these words, for, according to the tenor of these words I have made with you a covenant, and with Israel.'
34.28: And he is there with Jehovah forty days and forty nights; bread he has not eaten, and water he has not drunk; and he writes on the tables the matters of the covenant--the ten matters.
34.29: And it comes to pass, when Moses is coming down from mount Sinai (and the two tables of the testimony are in the hand of Moses in his coming down from the mount), that Moses has not known that the skin of his face has shone in His speaking with him,
34.30: and Aaron sees--all the sons of Israel also--Moses, and indeed, the skin of his face has shone, and they are afraid of coming nigh to him.
34.31: And Moses calls to them, and Aaron and all the princes in the company return to him, and Moses speaks to them;
34.32: and afterwards have all the sons of Israel come nigh, and he charges them with all that Jehovah has spoken with him in mount Sinai.
34.33: And Moses finishes speaking with them, and puts on his face a vail;
34.34: and in the going in of Moses before Jehovah to speak with Him, he turns aside the vail until his coming out; and he has come out and has spoken to the sons of Israel that which he is commanded;
34.35: and the sons of Israel have seen the face of Moses that the skin of the face of Moses has shone, and Moses has put back the vail on his face until his going in to speak with Him.

35.1: And Moses assembles all the company of the sons of Israel, and says to them, `These are the things which Jehovah has commanded--to do them:
35.2: Six days is work done, and on the seventh day there is to you a holy day, a sabbath of rest to Jehovah; any who does work in it is put to death;
35.3: you do not burn a fire in any of your dwellings on the sabbath-day.'
35.4: And Moses speaks to all the company of the sons of Israel, saying, `This is the thing which Jehovah has commanded, saying,
35.5: Take you from among you a heave-offering to Jehovah; every one whose heart is willing does bring it, --the heave-offering of Jehovah, --gold, and silver, and brass,
35.6: and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and linen, and goats' hair,
35.7: and rams' skins made red, and badgers' skins, and shittim wood,
35.8: and oil for the light, and spices for the anointing oil, and for the spice perfume,
35.9: and shoham stones, and stones for settings, for an ephod, and for a breastplate.
35.10: `And all the wise-hearted among you come in, and make all that Jehovah has commanded:
35.11: `The tabernacle, its tent, and its covering, its hooks, and its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets,
35.12: `The ark and its staves, the mercy-seat, and the vail of the covering,
35.13: `The table and its staves, and all its vessels, and the bread of the presence,
35.14: `And the candlestick for the light, and its vessels, and its lamps, and the oil for the light,
35.15: `And the altar of perfume, and its staves, and the anointing oil, and the spice perfume, and the covering of the opening at the opening of the tabernacle,
35.16: `The altar of burnt-offering and the brazen grate which it has, its staves, and all its vessels, the laver and its base,
35.17: `The hangings of the court, its pillars, and their sockets, and the covering of the gate of the court,
35.18: `The pins of the tabernacle, and the pins of the court, and their cords,
35.19: `The coloured garments, to do service in the sanctuary, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons to act as priest in.'
35.20: And all the company of the sons of Israel go out from the presence of Moses,
35.21: and they come in--every man whom his heart has lifted up, and every one whom his spirit has made willing--they have brought in the heave-offering of Jehovah for the work of the tent of meeting, and for all its service, and for the holy garments.
35.22: And they come in--the men with the women--every willing-hearted one--they have brought in nose-ring, and ear-ring, and seal-ring, and necklace, all golden goods, even every one who has waved a wave-offering of gold to Jehovah.
35.23: And every man with whom has been found blue, and purple, and scarlet, and linen, and goats' hair, and rams' skins made red, and badgers' skins, have brought them in;
35.24: every one lifting up a heave-offering of silver and brass have brought in the heave-offering of Jehovah; and every one with whom has been found shittim wood for any work of the service brought it in.
35.25: And every wise-hearted woman has spun with her hands, and they bring in yarn, the blue, and the purple, the scarlet, and the linen;
35.26: and all the women whose heart has lifted them up in wisdom, have spun the goats' hair.
35.27: And the princes have brought in the shoham stones, and the stones for settings, for the ephod, and for the breastplate,
35.28: and the spices, and the oil for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the spice perfume;
35.29: every man and woman (whom their heart has made willing to bring in for all the work which Jehovah commanded to be done by the hand of Moses) of the sons of Israel brought in a willing-offering to Jehovah.
35.30: And Moses says to the sons of Israel, `See, Jehovah has called by name Bezaleel, son of Uri, son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah,
35.31: and He does fill him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all work,
35.32: even to devise devices to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
35.33: and in graving of stones for settings, and in graving of wood to work in any work of design.
35.34: `And to direct He has put in his heart, he and Aholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan;
35.35: He has filled them with wisdom of heart to do every work, of engraver, and designer, and embroiderer (in blue, and in purple, in scarlet, and in linen), and weaver, who do any work, and of designers of designs.

36.1: And Bezaleel, and Aholiab, and every wise-hearted man, in whom Jehovah has given wisdom and understanding to know to do every work of the service of the sanctuary, have done according to all that Jehovah commanded.
36.2: And Moses calls to Bezaleel, and to Aholiab, and to every wise-hearted man in whose heart Jehovah has given wisdom, every one whom his heart lifted up, to come near to the work to do it.
36.3: And they take from before Moses all the heave-offering which the sons of Israel have brought in for the work of the service of the sanctuary to do it; and still they have brought in to him a willing-offering morning by morning.
36.4: And all the wise men, who are doing all the work of the sanctuary, come each from his work which they are doing,
36.5: and speak to Moses, saying, `The people are multiplying to bring in more than sufficient for the service of the work which Jehovah commanded to make.'
36.6: And Moses commands, and they cause a voice to pass over through the camp, saying, `Let not man or woman make any more work for the heave-offering of the sanctuary;' and the people are restrained from bringing,
36.7: and the work has been sufficient for them, for all the work, to do it, and to leave.
36.8: And all the wise-hearted ones among the doers of the work make the tabernacle; ten curtains of twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, with cherubs, work of a designer, he has made them.
36.9: The length of the one curtain is eight and twenty by the cubit, and the breadth of the one curtain four by the cubit; one measure is to all the curtains.
36.10: And he joins the five curtains one to another, and the other five curtains he has joined one to another;
36.11: and he makes loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain, at the end, in the joining; so he has made in the edge of the outmost curtain, in the joining of the second;
36.12: fifty loops he has made in the one curtain, and fifty loops has he made in the end of the curtain which is in the joining of the second; the loops are taking hold one on another.
36.13: And he makes fifty hooks of gold, and joins the curtains one to another by the hooks, and the tabernacle is one.
36.14: And he makes curtains of goats' hair for a tent over the tabernacle; eleven curtains he has made them;
36.15: the length of the one curtain is thirty by the cubit, and the breadth of the one curtain is four cubits; one measure is to the eleven curtains;
36.16: and he joins the five curtains apart, and the six curtains apart.
36.17: And he makes fifty loops on the outer edge of the curtain, in the joining; and fifty loops he has made on the edge of the curtain which is joining the second;
36.18: and he makes fifty hooks of brass to join the tent--to be one;
36.19: and he makes a covering for the tent of rams' skins made red, and a covering of badgers' skins above.
36.20: And he makes the boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood, standing up;
36.21: ten cubits is the length of the one board, and a cubit and a half the breadth of the one board;
36.22: two handles are to the one board, joined one to another; so he has made for all the boards of the tabernacle.
36.23: And he makes the boards for the tabernacle; twenty boards for the south side southward;
36.24: and forty sockets of silver he has made under the twenty boards, two sockets under the one board for its two handles, and two sockets under the other board for its two handles.
36.25: And for the second side of the tabernacle, for the north side, he has made twenty boards,
36.26: and their forty sockets of silver, two sockets under the one board, and two sockets under the other board;
36.27: and for the sides of the tabernacle, westward, has he made six boards;
36.28: and two boards has he made for the corners of the tabernacle, in the two sides;
36.29: and they have been twins below, and together they are twins at its head, at the one ring; so he has done to both of them at the two corners;
36.30: and there have been eight boards; and their sockets of silver are sixteen sockets, two sockets under the one board.
36.31: And he makes bars of shittim wood, five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
36.32: and five bars for the boards of the second side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle, for the sides westward;
36.33: and he makes the middle bar to enter into the midst of the boards from end to end;
36.34: and the boards he has overlaid with gold, and their rings he has made of gold, places for bars, and he overlays the bars with gold.
36.35: And he makes the vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen, work of a designer he has made it, with cherubs;
36.36: and he makes for it four pillars of shittim wood, and overlays them with gold; their pegs are of gold; and he casts for them four sockets of silver.
36.37: And he makes a covering for the opening of the tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen, work of an embroiderer,
36.38: also its five pillars, and their pegs; and he overlaid their tops and their fillets with gold, and their five sockets are brass.

37.1: And Bezaleel makes the ark of shittim wood, two cubits and a half its length, and a cubit and a half its breadth, and a cubit and a half its height;
37.2: and he overlays it with pure gold within and without, and makes for it a wreath of gold round about;
37.3: and he casts for it four rings of gold, on its four feet, even two rings on its one side, and two rings on its second side;
37.4: and he makes staves of shittim wood, and overlays them with gold,
37.5: and he brings in the staves into the rings, by the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.
37.6: And he makes a mercy-seat of pure gold, two cubits and a half its length, and a cubit and a half its breadth;
37.7: and he makes two cherubs of gold, of beaten work he has made them, at the two ends of the mercy-seat;
37.8: one cherub at the end on this side, and one cherub at the end on that, out of the mercy-seat he has made the cherubs, at its two ends;
37.9: and the cherubs are spreading out wings on high, covering over the mercy-seat with their wings, and their faces are one toward another; toward the mercy-seat have the faces of the cherubs been.
37.10: And he makes the table of shittim wood; two cubits its length, and a cubit its breadth, and a cubit and a half its height,
37.11: and overlays it with pure gold, and makes for it a wreath of gold round about.
37.12: And he makes for it a border of a handbreadth round about, and makes a wreath of gold for its border round about;
37.13: and he casts for it four rings of gold, and puts the rings on the four corners which are to its four feet;
37.14: over-against the border have the rings been, places for staves to bear the table.
37.15: And he makes the staves of shittim wood, and overlays them with gold, to bear the table;
37.16: and he makes the vessels which are upon the table, its dishes, and its bowls, and its cups, and the cups by which they pour out, of pure gold.
37.17: And he makes the candlestick of pure gold; of beaten work he has made the candlestick, its base, and its branch, its calyxes, its knops, and its flowers, have been of the same;
37.18: and six branches are coming out of its sides, three branches of the candlestick out of its one side, and three branches of the candlestick out of its second side;
37.19: three calyxes, made like almonds, in the one branch, a knop and a flower; and three calyxes, made like almonds, in another branch, a knop and a flower; so to the six branches which are coming out of the candlestick.
37.20: And in the candlestick are four calyxes, made like almonds, its knops, and its flowers,
37.21: and a knop under the two branches of the same, and a knop under the two branches of the same, and a knop under the two branches of the same, are to the six branches which are coming out of it;
37.22: their knops and their branches have been of the same; all of it one beaten work of pure gold.
37.23: And he makes its seven lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuff-dishes, of pure gold;
37.24: of a talent of pure gold he has made it, and all its vessels.
37.25: And he makes the perfume-altar of shittim wood; a cubit its length, and a cubit its breadth (square), and two cubits its height; its horns have been of the same;
37.26: and he overlays it with pure gold, its top and its sides round about, and its horns; and he makes for it a wreath of gold round about;
37.27: and two rings of gold he has made for it under its wreath, at its two corners, at its two sides, for places for staves to bear it with them.
37.28: And he makes the staves of shittim wood, and overlays them with gold;
37.29: and he makes the holy anointing oil, and the pure spice-perfume--work of a compounder.

38.1: And he makes the altar of burnt-offering of shittim wood, five cubits its length, and five cubits its breadth (square), and three cubits its height;
38.2: and he makes its horns on its four corners; its horns have been of the same; and he overlays it with brass;
38.3: and he makes all the vessels of the altar, the pots, and the shovels, and the sprinkling-pans, the forks, and the fire-pans; all its vessels he has made of brass.
38.4: And he makes for the altar a brazen grate of net-work, under its border beneath, to its midst;
38.5: and he casts four rings for the four ends of the brazen grate--places for bars;
38.6: and he makes the staves of shittim wood, and overlays them with brass;
38.7: and he brings in the staves into the rings on the sides of the altar, to bear it with them; hollow with boards he made it.
38.8: And he makes the laver of brass, and its base of brass, with the looking-glasses of the women assembling, who have assembled at the opening of the tent of meeting.
38.9: And he makes the court; at the south side southward, the hangings of the court of twined linen, a hundred by the cubit,
38.10: their pillars are twenty, and their brazen sockets twenty, the pegs of the pillars and their fillets are silver;
38.11: and at the north side, a hundred by the cubit, their pillars are twenty, and their sockets of brass twenty; the pegs of the pillars and their fillets are silver;
38.12: and at the west side are hangings, fifty by the cubit; their pillars are ten, and their sockets ten; the pegs of the pillars and their fillets are silver;
38.13: and at the east side eastward fifty cubits.
38.14: The hangings on the side are fifteen cubits, their pillars three, and their sockets three,
38.15: and at the second side at the gate of the court, on this and on that, are hangings, fifteen cubits, their pillars three, and their sockets three;
38.16: all the hangings of the court round about are of twined linen,
38.17: and the sockets for the pillars of brass, the pegs of the pillars and their fillets of silver, and the overlaying of their tops of silver, and all the pillars of the court are filleted with silver.
